punchline: Most of what you achieve comes from a small slice of your time.
thirty_sec: Richard Koch argues that about 80 percent of our achievements come from about 20 percent of our time. So instead of squeezing more into the day, he calls for a time revolution: find the hours that produce the most value and do more of them, while cutting, shrinking or delegating the rest. Being busy, he warns, isn't the same as being effective.
question: Which few hours of your week produce most of your results?
